basics.name: Wen-Hsiu Hsu
basics.label: Frontend Engineer
basics.summary: Frontend Engineer specializing in Vue.js, Nuxt, and Tailwind CSS, with a background in industrial design and a strong eye for visual detail and user experience. Independently built the frontend of a course sales platform, led the upgrade from Vue 2 to Vue 3 and the migration from Webpack to Vite, and refactored code to make pages load about 3–5x faster. Recently, I've been building a personal homelab with Raspberry Pi and exploring workflow automation with n8n.

work.name: United Daily News Co., Ltd.
work.summary: Owned frontend development for online course platforms: built 'U Haoxue (U 好學)' solo and led the frontend architecture of 'Yike Jingxuan (一刻鯨選)'.
highlights: Sole frontend developer of 'U Haoxue (U 好學)', delivering course preview and checkout features with Nuxt.js; launched January 2026
Led frontend architecture of 'Yike Jingxuan (一刻鯨選)', building e-commerce-like course sales functionality
Encapsulated a video player plugin to enhance product extensibility
Refactored and optimized code, cutting load times by roughly 3–5x
Led the migration from Webpack to Vite and the upgrade from Vue 2 to Vue 3
Integrated Tailwind CSS to enhance development efficiency and code maintainability

projects.name: Dobby - LINE Bot
projects.description: A LINE bot for one-tap badminton sign-ups in a group chat. As the organizer of a casual badminton group, I replaced our copy-paste text sign-up chain, which kept breaking on formatting mistakes. Dobby uses the Notion workspace I already used for bookkeeping as its database, so there was nothing new to set up.
highlights: LINE Flex Message
Express.js
TypeScript
Notion API
